title: Breadcrumb
overview: A trail of ancestors so they know where this page sits.
apply_when: Deep IA; they may jump up a level.
not_when: Step progress in a wizard (progress / task_list) or primary nav (no record yet).

vs.why: pages of a list, not ancestors

role.overview: The path of where they are. Last item is the current page, not a loop.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Ancestors are links; the current page is text (or aria-current).
composition.not_when: Every item is the current page.

state.not_when: The only orientation is a logo.

accessibility.overview: The trail is a named navigation (Breadcrumb).
accessibility.not_when: A raw list with no nav name.

accessibility.overview: The last item is the current page.
accessibility.not_when: The last item is a link to this same URL with no current.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on each ancestor link.
